# auth-zitadel

<!-- BEGIN DECLARED (generated by scripts/wiki-compile.py — do not edit) -->

> Source comment, verbatim from `kustomization.yaml`:
>
> Zitadel — Cloud-native Identity Provider with built-in user management
>
> Replaces GoTrue and complements oauth2-proxy as the OIDC provider.
> Provides what oauth2-proxy lacks: user creation, RBAC, service accounts.
>
> Architecture:
> Zitadel (IdP + user DB + RBAC)
> ↓ OIDC
> oauth2-proxy (Traefik middleware, unchanged)
> ↓ ForwardAuth
> Protected apps
>
> oauth2-proxy changes only its provider config:
> provider: google → provider: oidc + oidc-issuer-url: https://zitadel.{domain}
>
> Zitadel concepts mapped to the factory:
> Organization  → Tenant (multi-org support for internal + external users)
> Project       → App group (ai-tools, monitoring, productivity)
> Application   → OIDC client (oauth2-proxy, open-webui, n8n)
> Role          → Access level (admin, viewer, operator)
> Service User  → Machine account (agents, pipelines, CI/CD)
>
> Zitadel uses Helm chart via Kustomize helmCharts generator.
> PostgreSQL uses the factory's own postgres component (not Bitnami Helm).
> Requires: kustomize with --enable-helm flag
>
> Usage:
> kubectl kustomize --enable-helm k8s/components/apps/auth/zitadel
>
> Dependencies (must be included in tenant overlay or use the zitadel-stack bundle):
> - k8s/components/apps/databases/postgres (with namePrefix: zitadel-)
>
> Tenant must provide:
> - A namespace (set via kustomization `namespace:` field)
> - Secret "zitadel-postgres-secret" with: POSTGRES_USER=zitadel, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, POSTGRES_DB=zitadel
> - Secret "zitadel-masterkey" with key "masterkey" (32-char encryption key)
> - Secret "zitadel-db-config" with key "config-yaml" containing FULL DB config:
> Database:
> postgres:
> Host: zitadel-postgres
> Port: 5432
> Database: zitadel
> User:
> Username: zitadel
> Password: <same as POSTGRES_PASSWORD>
> SSL:
> Mode: disable
> Admin:
> ExistingDatabase: zitadel
> Username: zitadel
> Password: <same as POSTGRES_PASSWORD>
> SSL:
> Mode: disable
> (configSecretName overrides configmapConfig — include everything, not just passwords)
> - Patch for ingress hostname (zitadel.example.com → zitadel.{tenant-domain})
> - Patch for oauth2-proxy to use Zitadel as OIDC provider
> - Patch for clusterrolebinding subject namespace (rbac/clusterrolebinding.yaml)
>
> Namespace is NOT set here — the consumer overlay sets it.
> This allows deploying Zitadel into any namespace (auth, identity, zitadel, etc.)
>
> All resources (Helm + kustomize) share the label:
> app.kubernetes.io/part-of: zitadel
>
> Consumer overlay example:
> namespace: auth
> resources:
> - ../../../../components/apps/auth/zitadel
